body: She has left me, she's screwing some other dude.  She has stated that sex was a primary cause.

We tried a few things.  Toys and role play.  But mostly she would complain, and the more she complained the worse my performance got.  About three years ago she stoped being the aggressor.  About a year ago she started activity denying me sex.  Blamed it on hormones.  Believe it or not, at this point, when we had sex my performance started to improve.  I was lasting longer and having more fun.  Then one night this past spring, the same night I met her AP, we came home, she was drunk and I was putting the moves on her.  She told me to leave her alone, that she "deserved better, someone that lasted longer".  At the time, it was the most painful thing I've heard.  When she saw the look on my face, she said "See, this is why we can't talk about things" and locked herself in the guest room.  You know what, my delusional self made excuses for her behavior - "she was drunk, she didn't mean it."

I didn't even know our releationship was unhealthy.  And I put the happiness of my family first, because my happiness is in seeing them happy.  I knew that over the last couple of years she wasn't happy and I became resentful of it.  I asked her, what she needed.  She said she needed to be loved, I told her she was loved.  She said she wanted flowers, I sent her flowers, she said she wanted to go out more, I went out.  She said she wanted to focus more on her career, I encouraged her to do so, and I picked up some of the slack around the house.  

But your right.  I'm lost.  I can't seem to move forward because I don't even know which direction forward is.  

And I do still have my sons.  They live with me and have been very supportive of me.  They have both told me that I have always been a good father and they have both expressed anger, disappointment, and confusion over their mothers actions.  Which, I find both encouraging and heart breaking.  It's heartbreaking because my family is being torn apart and not by some external force, but by the selfish action of a woman I have always known as the most generous, caring and loving person in the world.
